title: perf: compute DAU/WAU from daily user states
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The Users & Balances Grafana dashboard now merges generation_usage_hourly user states once per day and calculates WAU with a seven-day RANGE window, instead of cross-joining every displayed day with every hourly row. The 90-day query fell from 11.6 s to 0.37 s, the 30-day query from 1.7 s to 0.18 s, and the 7-day query from 0.27 s to 0.13 s. DAU and WAU results retain the same users, funding filter, and columns; all displayed days across the three ranges matched production results in Grafana 13.2.3.
